titles.native: 霊剣山 叡智への資格

description:
After two years of studying within the Reiken clan, Ou Riku and other inexperienced disciples are ordered to descend to the temporal world for further studies, and Ōriku embarks the journey back to his birthplace.

(Source: Anime News Network)
